title: An Australian minister says the eSafety Commissioner plans to sue Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube over alleged breaches of the under-16 social media ban (Angus Whitley/Bloomberg)
summary: Angus Whitley / Bloomberg: An Australian minister says the eSafety Commissioner plans to sue Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube over alleged breaches of the under-16 social media ban — Australia's government is set to sue Facebook, TikTok and other major digital platforms for alleged non-compliance …
